note: System LongPi Ages regroup the terms of the whole-body model by body system. No term is new: domain terms are the engine's own (params.json: domains, calibration); blood-clock terms are the nine PhenoAge analytes, each assigned to the system printed for it in Table 1 of Levine ME, et al. Aging (Albany NY) 2018;10:573 (PMID 29676998): albumin - liver, creatinine - kidney, glucose - metabolic, C-reactive protein - inflammation, lymphocyte percent / mean cell volume / red cell distribution width / white blood cell count - immune, alkaline phosphatase - liver.
analyte_source: Levine 2018（PMID 29676998）表 1 的系数与系统标签；相对 NHANES 同龄同性别参考值（data/phenoage_analyte_reference.json）

systems.missing_zh: 需要血压（家庭血压或体检血压）

not_counted.marker: ApoB、Lp(a)、LDL 颗粒数、心率变异性

systems.missing_zh: 需要一次含九项的血液检测（白蛋白、肌酐、葡萄糖、CRP、淋巴细胞百分比、MCV、RDW、碱性磷酸酶、白细胞）

methylation_organ.rule_zh: 厂商甲基化报告印出的器官年龄作为单独的佐证行显示，不改变系统年龄的数值。厂商差值 = 器官年龄 − 采样时的日历年龄；与系统差值相差超过 2 倍实验室间系统差异（params.json: methylation.s_lab）时标为不一致。
